high_rye_barrel_proof.description: High-rye mash bill (>30% rye), barrel proof (107+ proof), bold and spicy
high_rye_barrel_proof.pairing_notes: The rye spice and high proof stand up to full-bodied cigars; the heat mellows against dark wrappers and bold flavors

wheated.description: Wheated mash bill (wheat replaces rye), softer and sweeter, lower proof (80-90)
wheated.pairing_notes: Soft wheat sweetness complements milder cigars; won't overpower delicate wrappers. The caramel/vanilla notes enhance creamy cigars

high_corn_sweet.description: High-corn mash bill (>70% corn), sweet and full-bodied, standard proof (80-90)
high_corn_sweet.pairing_notes: Sweet corn notes bridge the gap between medium and full cigars; versatile pairing that works with most profiles

rye_heavy_bourbon.description: High-rye bourbon at standard proof (80-90), spicier than sweet
rye_heavy_bourbon.pairing_notes: Rye spice mirrors the pepper in Habano/Corojo wrappers; the 101 proof versions stand up to fuller cigars

peaty_islay.description: Peat-smoked barley from Islay, medicinal and smoky, bold
peaty_islay.pairing_notes: Peat smoke mirrors the smoke/earth in full-bodied cigars; the medicinal notes complement leather and espresso flavors. Avoid with mild cigars — it will overpower them

fruity_speyside.description: Unpeated or lightly peated, fruity and floral, elegant
fruity_speyside.pairing_notes: Orchard fruit and floral notes complement creamy/cedar cigars; the sherry influence pairs with honey and vanilla flavors

highland.description: Balanced, medium-bodied, slightly floral with a dry finish
highland.pairing_notes: Versatile and balanced; works with medium cigars where Islay would overpower. The dry finish cleanses the palate between puffs

sherry_finished.description: Aged or finished in sherry casks (Oloroso/PX), rich and dark
sherry_finished.pairing_notes: Sherry sweetness and dried fruit richness complements dark chocolate and espresso notes in full-bodied cigars; the tannins match leather/earth

campbeltown.description: Briny, smoky, full-bodied with a maritime character
campbeltown.pairing_notes: Briny, smoky character adds a savory dimension to full cigars; works best with Nicaraguan and Cuban cigars that have earth and leather notes

lowland.pairing_notes: Delicate and light; pairs with mild cigars without overpowering. The grassy/floral notes complement Connecticut wrapper creaminess

high_rye_straight.description: 100% rye or high-rye mash (95%+ rye), spicy and bold
high_rye_straight.pairing_notes: Intense rye spice (clove, cinnamon, black pepper) amplifies the pepper in full-bodied cigars; the boldness requires a strong cigar to balance

maryland_style.description: Softer, fruitier rye style, less aggressive than Pennsylvania rye
maryland_style.pairing_notes: Softer rye character with fruit notes works with medium-full cigars; the pepper is present but balanced by sweetness

canadian.description: Canadian rye, often blended, lighter and smoother
canadian.pairing_notes: Smoother and lighter than American rye; versatile with medium cigars. The caramel sweetness bridges to Cameroon and Connecticut wrappers

single_pot_still.description: Irish single pot still, spicy and full with green apple notes
single_pot_still.pairing_notes: Unique pot still spice with orchard fruit; works well with medium cigars that have cedar and cream notes

blended_irish.description: Light, smooth, approachable blended Irish whiskey
blended_irish.pairing_notes: Light and smooth; won't overpower mild cigars. The honey/vanilla notes complement Connecticut wrapper creaminess

single_malt.description: Japanese single malt, delicate, balanced, often Mizunara oak
single_malt.pairing_notes: Delicate Mizunara oak adds coconut and spice; pairs elegantly with medium cigars. The balance means it won't overpower but will enhance cedar and floral notes

aged_demerara.description: Demerara rum from Guyana, dark, molasses-rich, often column still
aged_demerara.pairing_notes: Dark molasses and caramel notes mirror the chocolate/espresso in full-bodied cigars; the richness requires a bold cigar to balance

high_ester_jamaican.description: Jamaican high-ester rum, funky, aromatic, pot-still driven
high_ester_jamaican.pairing_notes: Funky ester notes (banana, overripe fruit) add complexity to medium-full cigars; the intensity works with Nicaraguan and Cuban cigars

spanish_anjeo.description: Spanish-style aged rum, smooth, sweet, solera-aged
spanish_anjeo.pairing_notes: Smooth sweetness with sherry-like qualities; versatile with medium to medium-full cigars. The caramel/toffee pairs beautifully with Cameroon and Connecticut wrappers

agricole.description: Agricole rhum from French Caribbean, made from fresh cane juice, grassy and vegetal
agricole.pairing_notes: Grassy, vegetal character from fresh cane juice; pairs with cigars that have herbal/floral notes. The olive/brine quality works with Cuban cigars

cuban_rum.description: Cuban-style white or aged rum, light and clean
cuban_rum.pairing_notes: Light and clean; the traditional pairing for Cuban cigars. The subtlety won't overpower mild-to-medium Cuban cigars; the vanilla/cedar complements aged Habano wrapper

vsop.description: VSOP Cognac, aged 4+ years, balanced and approachable
vsop.pairing_notes: Balanced fruit and oak; works with medium cigars. The dried fruit and vanilla complement cedar and cream notes. A classic pairing for Dominican cigars

xo.description: XO Cognac, aged 10+ years, deep, rich, complex
xo.pairing_notes: Deep, rich, and complex; pairs with full-bodied cigars. The rancio and dried fruit notes match leather and dark chocolate. A luxury pairing for Cuban and premium Nicaraguan cigars

armagnac.description: Armagnac from Gascony, rustic, single-distilled, more robust than Cognac
armagnac.pairing_notes: Rustic and robust; the prune and roasted nut character pairs with dark, earthy cigars. More aggressive than Cognac — needs a bold cigar

spanish_brandy.description: Spanish brandy, solera-aged, sweet and rich
spanish_brandy.pairing_notes: Sherry-influenced sweetness; works with medium to medium-full cigars. The dried fruit and walnut notes complement Cameroon and Habano wrappers

anejo.description: Añejo tequila, aged 1-3 years in oak, smooth and complex
anejo.pairing_notes: Oak-aged agave with caramel and cocoa; the agave pepper complements Habano/Corojo spice. A natural pairing for Mexican-grown tobacco

reposado.description: Reposado tequila, aged 2-11 months, balanced between agave and oak
reposado.pairing_notes: Balanced agave and oak; pairs with medium cigars. The citrus/pepper notes complement Connecticut and Habano wrappers without overwhelming

mezcal.description: Mezcal, smoke-roasted agave, smoky and earthy
mezcal.pairing_notes: Smoke and earth mirror the smoke/earth in full-bodied cigars; the agave sweetness adds complexity. Pairs best with Maduro and Broadleaf wrappers

tawny.description: Tawny Port, oxidative aging, nutty and caramelized
tawny.pairing_notes: Nutty caramel notes match Maduro sweetness; the oxidative character complements dark chocolate and espresso. A classic after-dinner pairing

ruby.description: Ruby Port, fruity and full-bodied, less oxidative
ruby.pairing_notes: Fruity and bold; the dark fruit complements chocolate and cedar in medium-full cigars. Less sweet than tawny, more fruit-forward

oloroso.description: Oloroso Sherry, dry, rich, walnut and leather
oloroso.pairing_notes: Dry, nutty, and complex; the walnut/leather notes mirror the same flavors in full cigars. A sophisticated pairing for Cuban and Maduro cigars

amontillado.description: Amontillado Sherry, between fino and oloroso, nutty with salinity
amontillado.pairing_notes: Nutty with a saline edge; the almond/salt notes complement Cuban cigars. The complexity bridges mild and full cigars

fino.description: Fino Sherry, dry, pale, biologically aged, delicate
fino.pairing_notes: Delicate and dry; pairs with mild cigars only. The flor-aging gives bread/almond notes that complement mild Connecticut cigars

madeira.description: Fortified wine from Madeira, heated and oxidized, complex
madeira.pairing_notes: The oxidative heating process creates caramel and nutty complexity; pairs with full cigars. The acidity cleanses the palate between puffs

banyuls.description: Sweet fortified wine from Roussillon, Grenache-based
examples: Domaine de la Rectorie Banyuls Rimage
banyuls.pairing_notes: Red fruit and chocolate notes; essentially a dessert wine for cigars. The cherry/chocolate pairing is perfect for Maduro wrappers

imperial_stout.pairing_notes: Roasted malt mirrors espresso/chocolate in full cigars; the ABV warmth matches full-bodied smoke. A perfect cold-weather pairing

belgian_quadrupel.description: Belgian Quad, rich, dark fruit, high ABV (10%+)
belgian_quadrupel.pairing_notes: Dark fruit and spice complexity; the Belgian yeast esters complement leather and earth in full cigars. The sweetness balances pepper

barleywine.pairing_notes: Rich malt backbone with hop bitterness; the caramel/toffee pairs with Maduro sweetness while the hops complement pepper

amber_ale.description: Medium-bodied amber ale, balanced malt and hops
amber_ale.pairing_notes: Balanced and easy-drinking; the malt sweetness complements mild-medium cigars without overpowering

czech_pilsner.pairing_notes: Crisp and refreshing; the carbonation cleanses the palate. The bready malt and spicy hops complement mild cigars. A summer pairing

ipa.description: India Pale Ale, hoppy and bitter, citrusy
ipa.pairing_notes: Hop bitterness and citrus can work with pepper-forward cigars; the tropical fruit notes complement Habano. Divisive — some smokers hate the hop bitterness with cigars

double_espresso.description: Double shot espresso, dark roast, no sugar
double_espresso.pairing_notes: The classic cigar pairing. Bitter espresso oils coat the palate and enhance chocolate/earth notes. Dark roast matches full cigars; a morning espresso pairs with a medium cigar

flat_white.description: Flat white, whole milk, medium roast
flat_white.pairing_notes: Milk softens the coffee; pairs with mild-medium cigars. The cream/caramel notes complement Connecticut wrappers. A morning cigar pairing

cuban_coffee.description: Cuban-style cafecito, demerara sugar, dark and sweet
cuban_coffee.pairing_notes: The demerara sugar adds sweetness that bridges to the cigar's natural tobacco sweetness; a traditional Cuban pairing. The dark roast matches Habano intensity

cold_brew.description: Cold brew coffee, smooth, low acidity, served cold
cold_brew.pairing_notes: Low acidity means it won't clash with the cigar; the smooth chocolate notes work with most cigars. Served cold, it's refreshing in warm weather

dark_chocolate_85.pairing_notes: The most universal cigar pairing food. The cacao butter coats the palate and enhances the cigar's chocolate notes. Single-origin chocolate (Madagascar, Ecuador) adds terroir complexity

aged_manchego.description: Aged Manchego, 12+ months, sheep's milk, nutty and crystalline
aged_manchego.pairing_notes: The crystalline texture and nutty/salty profile complement medium-full cigars. The salt enhances the cigar's sweetness. A classic tapas-and-cigar pairing

bbq_brisket.description: Smoked BBQ brisket, pepper-rubbed, post-oak smoked
bbq_brisket.pairing_notes: The smoke ring and pepper rub mirror a full-bodied cigar's smoke and pepper. The rendered fat coats the palate, softening the cigar's tannins. A backyard BBQ pairing

almond_biscotti.pairing_notes: The almond and anise complement cedar and spice in the cigar. The crunch and slight sweetness make it a perfect mid-smoke palate cleanser. Dip in coffee or amaretto

dark_chocolate_70.pairing_notes: Balanced sweetness and cocoa; more approachable than 85%. Pairs with medium-full cigars where the chocolate notes are present but not dominant

blue_cheese.description: Aged blue cheese, pungent, salty, creamy
blue_cheese.pairing_notes: The pungent salt and umami amplify the earth and leather in full cigars. The creaminess mellows tannins. A bold pairing for bold cigars only

candied_ginger.pairing_notes: The ginger spice complements pepper in the cigar while the sweetness bridges to the tobacco's natural sweetness. A palate cleanser between puffs
